newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian Q1 domestic investments 35.5 pct down.
newsitem.headline: Romanian Q1 domestic investments 35.5 pct down.

text.p: Domestic investment in Romania plunged 35.5 percent in January-March as investment in equipment fell due to liquidity shortages, a National Statistics Board (CNS) report showed on Thursday.
Local economists said the drop was triggered by a surge in inflation earlier this year -- hitting a record 30.7 percent in March after price liberalisation.

The CNS said the manufacturing industry took 20.9 percent of the 3.99 trillion lei worth of three-month investment, with equipment accounting for 43.1 percent of investment spending, down from 55 in the year-ago period.

Retail trade, real estate and banking activities took 28.9 percent of January-March investment. The private sector accounted for 46.4 percent of three-month investment, down from 52 percent in the equivalent period of 1996.
Government forecasts show investment rising by two percent this year after a 4.5 percent increase in 1996 and a growth of 8.1 percent in 1995.
